title: My Senpai is Annoying
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Futaba Igarashi, a small, hardworking young office worker, is constantly teased by her huge, loud and kind-hearted senior colleague Harumi Takeda. Short comic chapters follow office mishaps, coworkers' side romances and the slow growth of feelings between the two. It began as a Twitter comic and ran to thirteen volumes.
life_message: Good work and a good life come from colleagues who look out for each other, even when they are annoying.
